policy: Dated aggregate asking-price observations for buyer planning. These are not completed sales, dealer quotes, or a live marketplace feed. No listing photos or seller content are reproduced.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; retained ten Local Used 2005 offers. Excluded Foreign Used, one described as a 2004 car, and one ambiguous upgraded car. Interpolated quartiles of the ten asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: The marketplace page was last crawled about six days before this review, so availability was not verified today. Repeated sellers, mileage, mechanical condition, and modifications may shift this small sample. This is a local buying band, not a new-import quote; a 2005 model falls outside both age thresholds on the official trade portal in 2026. The portal pages conflict on the threshold, so confirm the specific vehicle with Customs before any import decision. Inspect the car and documents before paying.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; 19 marked Foreign Used. Values are the lower quartile, median, and upper quartile of those asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.
observations.limitations: The result cards did not establish exact engine displacement, while the source-market comparison uses 1.8L. Promoted placements, duplicate ads, trim, mileage, condition, and seller claims may skew this small sample. Prices and availability can change. Inspect the car and verify customs documents before paying.

corroboratingSources.method: Nine visible 2018 Corolla listings marked foreign used; excluded 2008 vehicles returned by this search page. Median of asking prices, not completed sales.

observations.sourceName: Autochek Ghana 2018 Toyota Corolla Accra results
observations.method: Reviewed 16 visible year-filtered result cards on 2026-09-27. Retained eleven Foreign Used, non-hybrid, four-cylinder Corollas with odometers of at least 10,000 km or the equivalent: GH¢ 168,550, 170,000, 187,777, 188,950, 192,979, 194,050, 194,050, 198,181, 198,181, 203,383, and 214,450. Excluded one hybrid, one anomalous two-cylinder entry, two zero-odometer entries, and one 8,000 km entry. Interpolated quartiles, rounded to the nearest GH¢ 1,000. The separate Jiji check was not blended.
observations.limitations: Engine displacement is not shown on Autochek's result cards, while the source-market sample is specifically 1.8L. Trims, mileage, condition, listing duplication, and availability can change the band. These are asking prices, not completed sales or import valuations. Obtain an exact 1.8L local quote and inspect the car before comparing it with the small dated UAE purchase-price sample.

corroboratingSources.method: Separate first-page indexed snapshot, crawled about a week before review. Excluded Local Used, wrong-year descriptions, and offers without explicit displacement. Current listing availability was not verified; this narrower check is not blended with Autochek.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; excluded two Local Used offers, one described as registered despite its Foreign Used label, and one with an ambiguous 2017/2018 year. Interpolated quartiles of 16 Foreign Used RX350 asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000.

observations.method: First 20 visible results reviewed; all were labelled Foreign Used and described as 2016 ES350. Interpolated quartiles of the asking prices, rounded to the nearest NGN 100,000. An Autochek Lagos sample is reported separately.
